content: Jisu okv Jakias
Jisu Jeriko nga vngpitla vngto.
Ho hoka lampu naayanv mvnwng lokv kaiyachok nvgo dooto vkvgv aminv Jakias, nw achialvbv nyitvto.
Nw Jisu yvvdw kaadubv vla rikwto, vbvritola nw adwngnv nyi gubv rito okv nyipam v twngtvnam lvkwnglo nw Jisunyi kaapa nyumato.
Vkvlvgabv nw nyipam a jokcho yala koksitkokrik singnv gulo gechato Jisu ho lamtv hoka vngpit rilo ninyia kaadubv vla.
Vdwlo Jisu ho hoka vngchi tokudw, nw kaadung toku, okv Jakiasnyi minto, “Baapubv itoku, Jakias, ogulvgavbolo ngo silu noogv naam lo doorung tvvdunv.”
Jakias baapubv geludanv ngv achialvbv himpula ninyia alvbv aamu toku.
Nyi mvnwng hum kaanv vdwv arwnglo mimi sinyato, “So nyi angv si rimurnv nyi gv naam lo nyen bv aadunv!”
Jakias dakrap dato okv Jisunyi minto, “Tamsarnv, tvvrialabv! Ngo ngoogv yikungyira nga tunggonyi heemanv vdwa jireku, okv ngo yvvnyi dvkup pvkudw, ngo ninyia api yagu jiya reku.”
Jisu ninyia minto, “Silu so gv naam so ringnam v aapvku, ho lvga so nyi si Abraham gvka husi v.
Nyia Kuunyilo ngv nyekunv vdwa makarla ringdukubv aapvnv.”
Ain lokdwng lo minchisinam
Nyi vdwgv um tvria rilo, Jisu mimbwngla minchisinam go bunua mintamto. Nw vjak Jerusalem lo aachi dvlvbv ritoku, okv Pwknvyarnv gv Karv ngv aadaribo vla bunu mvngnyato.
Vkvlvgabv nw minto “Hoka ho nyi ako kaibv mvngdvnam go dooto nw aduko mookulo vngtv nvgo Dvbv bv mvku dvbv vla, ho kochingbv nw naam aakur dubv vla rungto.
Nw gv vngrap maadvbv, nw ninyigv pakbu vring vdwa gokkumto okv bunua ain lokdwng vkv charchak go jigvrila minto, ‘Kaatoka ngoogv vngro rilo nonu so sam ogugo pwlwkpaalwk la pwtam paatam rila rinv.’
Vjak, ninyigv mookugv nyi vdwv ninyia kaanwng mato, okv vkvlvgabv bunu gindungpingko vdwa mimu dubv vla ninyigv kochinglo vngmuto, ‘Ngonu so nyi sum ngonugv Dvbv bv vla mvngma dunv.’”
“Nyi anga Dvbv bv mvtoku okv aakur toku. Nw pakbu vdwa ninyigv kaagialo lvkin gubv aadum dubv minto, bunu vdwgo pwkumpaakum pvdw um kaadubv vla.
Atokchogv angv aatoku okv minto, ‘Tamsarnv, ngo ain lokdwng charring go paakumpv noogv charkin go jiku lokv.’
‘Alvbv ripv,’ nw mintoku: ‘No alvnv pakbu go! no miangnv yikungyira lo jwkjwkvrwkbv rinv go, ngo nam pamtv vring nga rigvdubv jidunv.’
Anyi nvnv pakbu angv aato okv minto, ‘Tamsarnv, ngo ain lokdwng charngu go paakumpv no gv charkin go jiku lokv.’
So anga nw minto, ‘No pamtv angu a rigvnvbv rire.’
Pakbu gunv aato okv minto, ‘Tamsarnv, siinv noogv ain lokdwng ngv; ngo sam jeriap gulo vvsi pvnv.
Ngo nam busuto, ogulvgavbolo no nyi kingin nvgo. No nokv gvnga maka naadu okv noogv paklwk maanam humka nvvdu.’

Nw pakbu anga minto, ‘No alvmanv pakbu! ngo noogv mvnggwngbv alvmanv gaam um minnvla nam miakayare! No nga gwlwknv nyi go, ngo gvngv manv ngaaka naanv gubv okv ngoogv paklwk maanam humka nvvnv gubv chimpvi.
Alvdu, vbvrikunamv, no ogubv ngoogv morko nga Benk morko kuu bvngkulo lwkma pvnv? Vbvrikunamv ngo naakur rikunyi morko kuu a lvkobv naaku svnga.’
Vbvrikunamv nw hoka daknv vdwa minto, ‘Nw gvlokv ain lokdwng nga naatokuka okv hum Pakbu ain lokdwng charring go doonv yanga jitoka.’
Vbvritola bunu ninyia minto, ‘Tamsarnv, nw lokdwng charring go doogvla doopv!’
‘Ngo nonua mindunv,’ nw mirwkto, ‘Nyidum mvnwngnga yvvdw ogugo doodunv, hum jidv yayare; vbvritola yvvdw ogugoka kaama dunv, ninyigv achukgo doogv namaka um ninyigv lokv naaritre.
Vjak, ngoogv nyiru minsunv vdwa yvvbunudw nga bunugv Dvbv bv mvnwng madunv vdwa, bunua so naalwk tvka okv ngoogv dooku soka mvki tokuka!’”
Jisu Jerusalem lo Dvbv bv aakunam
Jisu hum mintoku okv vbvrikunamv bunua vngchoyala Jerusalem bv vngto.
Nw Betpej okv Betani gv adar Olib moodw lo aarilo, nw lvbwlaksu anyigo vngcho moto
svbv mingvrila: “Vngnyika nonugv vnglwkjiku nampum alo; nonugv vnglwk rilo, nonu siak ako riokwka manamgo takpvla vvpvnamgo kaapare. Um paksoklaila soka aagv tvika.
Nyi gonv nonua hum ogubv paksok dunv vla minbo loka, Ahtu
sum dinchidukv vla ninyia minpa laka.”
Bunu bunugv lamtvlo vngkunamv Jisu gv bunua minam jvbv ogumvnwng nga paatoku.
Bunugv siak
a paksok rilo, ho gv atu v bunua minto, “nonuno um ogubv paksok dunvla?”
“Ahtu sum dinchidu,” bunu mirwkto,
okv bunu siak a naalaila Jisu gvlo aagv jitoku. Vbvrikunamv bunu bunugv vji a siak aolo puchato okv Jisunyi siak aolo chadubv ridurto.
Ninyigv siak aolo vngrilo nyi vdwv lamtvlo bunugv vji vdwa pipv nyato.

Vdwlo Nw Jerusalem gv nvchilo aatokudw, Olib moodw bv lamtv ilwk jiku mooku hoka, ninyigv lvbwlaksu vdwv twngtv rungbv bunugv ninyigvlo kaanam mvnwngnga Pwknvyarnvnyi umbonyikv vla okv ninyia hartvla minrap nyatoku:
“Pwknvyarnv ayalaka Dvbvnyi yvvdw Ahtu gv amin lokv aanvnga! Nyidomooku lo sarsopoyo reku okv Pwknvyarnv gvlo kairungbv!”
Vbvrikunamv nyipam lokv Parisis megonv Jisunyi minto. “Tamsarnv,” bunu minto “Noogv lvbwlaksu vdwa choibvkv vla minto!”
Jisu mirwkto, “Ngo nonua mindunv bunu choi kubolo, vlwng vdwv bunu atuv gamtv rungbv rumrapre.”
Jerusalem gv lvkwngbv Jisu gv kapnam
Nw pamtv lo aanwk lvlvto, okv vdwlo nw hum kaapa tokudw, nw ho gv lvgabv kapto,
minto, “Nonu silu sarsopoyo gv lvgalo ogugo aadu nvdw um chinv guloka! Vbvritola nonu vjak um kaapa kumare!
Nonua nonugv nyimak vdwv aagvrila goyumgochila vnglin chaalin momabv tumla vvpv dw alu v aariku.

Bunu nonua achuk goka dooku madubv mvyak mvchakre okv nonugv vlwngsvlu arwnglo doonv nyi vdwaka; vlwng pwgoka dookulo doomu mare, ogulvgavbolo nonu Pwknvyarnv gv vdwlo nonua ringdubv vla aanama kaachin manam lvkwnglo!”
Jisu Pwknvyarnvnaam lo aatoku
Vbvrikunamv Jisu Pwknvyarnvnaam lo vngtoku okv korvpachu pioknv vdwa charlin raptoku,
bunua minto, “So si Darwknv Kitaplo lvkdu, ‘Ngoogv Naam a kumgingku naam bv vla mindunv.’ Vbvritola nonu hum chonvmvvnv tosiku bv mvpv!”
Jisu alu gv dwkia Pwknvyarnvnaam arwnglo tamsarto. Nyibu butvnv vdwv, Pvbv tamsarnv vdwv, okv nyi vdwa rigvnv vdwv Jisunyi mvki dubv mvngtoku,
vbvritola bunu ninyia vbvridubv lamtv paanyu matoku, ogulvgavbolo nyi mvnwngngv ninyia tvvria bwngto, gamgoka nyemu nwngma vla mvngnyato.
